Situation. Wrenfield Health was losing complex cardiac cases to competing systems in central Ohio, and heart attack transfer times from its community hospitals were above target.

Approach. The team consolidated open-heart surgery and structural heart procedures at Wrenfield Regional Medical Center, extended diagnostic catheterization at Wrenfield North Hospital, and launched telecardiology at Wrenfield Lakeside Hospital. A single cardiology transfer center now coordinates STEMI transfers.

Results. Door-to-balloon time for transferred heart attack patients fell by 22 minutes, in-system retention of cardiac surgery cases rose 14 percent, and cardiology outpatient visits grew 11 percent within 12 months.
